excerpts.text: The launch (designated [Ariane flight VA256](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariane_flight_VA256 "Ariane flight VA256")) took place as scheduled at 12:20 UTC on 25 December 2021 on an [Ariane 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariane_5 "Ariane 5") rocket that lifted off from the [Guiana Space Centre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guiana_Space_Centre "Guiana Space Centre") in [French Guiana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Guiana "French Guiana").[[1]](#cite_note-AS-20211225-1)[[2]](#cite_note-NASA-20211227-2) Upon successful launch, NASA administrator Bill Nelson called it "a great day for planet Earth".[[3]](#cite_note-The_New_York_Times-3) The telescope was confirmed to be receiving power, starting a two-week deployment phase of its parts[[4]](#cite_note-Space_Explored_20212-4) and traveling to its target destination.[[5]](#cite_note-WP-202112252-5)[[6]](#cite_note-NYT-202112252-6)[[7]](#cite_note-NYT-20211225do2-7) A six-month commissioning phase followed of testing and calibrating scientific instruments, culminating in the first scientific results being publicly shared in July 2022.

excerpts.text: 1 PLANNING AND EXECUTION OF THE THREE MID-COURSE CORRECTION MANEUVERS FOR THE JAMES WEBB SPACE TELESCOPE Jeremy Petersen,* Karen Richon,† and Benjamin Stringer* The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) was successfully launched on De-cember 25, 2021 12:20 UTC on an Ariane 5 rocket out of Kourou, French Gui-ana on a direct, lower energy manifold transfer out to the Sun Earth-Moon (SEM) L2 point.

INTRODUCTION The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) successfully launched on December 25, 2021 12:20 UTC on an Ariane 5 rocket out of Kourou, French Guiana on a direct, low energy manifold out to the Sun Earth-Moon (SEM) L2 point.
JWST launched at the opening of the window right at 12:20 UTC.

excerpts.text:
* On December 21, 2021, NASA announced that the official planned launch date was delayed by one day to December 25, 2021 due to [adverse weather at the launch site](https://www.nasa.gov/feature/james-webb-space-telescope-launch-update)
* On December 25, 2021, the telescope was successfully launched, which Randall anticipated with this comic: [2559: December 25th Launch](/wiki/index.php/2559:_December_25th_Launch "2559: December 25th Launch").
